title: Page 180
transc:
SH Beckwith Balto  Washn Sept 17th 1864
Harriet Marshal Chart Despatch from Churn received
Repeats were given some libels ago to
send all Sugar Webbs and warwicks shylock
squadren states from Boston Girdle Grammar &
Bard to Brimstone by water on account
talbot numerous quitmans tulip Do you mean
that these repeats be suspended and the
new Webbs brought here or simply to
retain what are now here and on
their way here wiley Lady


SH Beckwith  Washn Sept 20th 1864
Nelly Oliver for Bellows You recollect the answer
you wrote tooth letter talbot College I took
to you at Chester tulip The copper heads
charge that the Barnard has interfered with your
arrangements but that correspondence completely contradicts the charge
and the publication would justify both you and
the Color Have you any objection to its
publication Please answer by whiff EB Washburn
